How to work each client

  1. True orphans first. Add an in-text link to each one from 2 or 3 related posts or its matching service page. If it is a dead or duplicate page, redirect it instead.
  2. Posts with no service-page link. Add 1 link to the closest service page, using the service keyword as the anchor.
  3. Weak service pages. Any service page with fewer than 3 in-text links gets links from its most related posts.
  4. Thin posts. Under 600 words: merge into a stronger post on the same topic and 301 it, expand it, or cut it. Check GSC clicks before cutting anything.

"True orphan" means no page in the sitemap links to it, including menus and footers. Blog archive pagination is not counted, since Google rarely crawls deep into it. Thin-post counts are word counts of the post body, so check a few before bulk action.
